rows.source_quality: medium for Smite; weak for the healer variant (2 posts)
rows.notes: Chastise -> Holy Fire -> instant Smite burst; favored among priest PvPers since CC2 over Shadow. Staff nerfed it twice for PvP ('We overshot Discipline by quite some, both in PvE and PvP').

rows.notes: Best mitigation toolkit (Shield Block crit/crush immunity, Shield Wall, Last Stand, Disarm) and the go-to progression tank because tier sets are tank sets; single-target and AoE threat trail bear and paladin after CC2. 1.18.1 added Shield Slam rank 5 (20% AP, 75% threat) and Defiance help, with staff promising a fuller Protection review later.

Still argued for on threat consistency (dual wield spreads threat over many hits, so one parry hurts less than a parried Shield Slam). No post-1.18.1 evaluation exists, and every 1.18.1 tank change favours deep Protection.

coverageMarkdown:
Companion to [`spec-role-matrix.md`](spec-role-matrix.md). Two things live here:

1. a **class × role coverage table** giving the source quality of each playbook, taken from the nine class `README.md` files (not re-judged here);
2. a **merged gaps list** across all nine classes — the things a future pass has to fill from local game data rather than the forum.

Source quality is the READMEs' own vocabulary: **strong** (multiple detailed, independent, corroborating sources), **medium** (one detailed source plus agreeing fragments, or good mechanics but thin standing), **weak** (opinion fragments, a single stale build link, or a section rather than a playbook), **none** (no source treats the class as filling that role). Where a README splits its judgement by topic or era, the table keeps the split.

## 1. Coverage table (class × role)

| Class | Tank | Healer | Melee DPS | Ranged DPS | PvP | Leveling |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Druid** | **strong** on stats/mechanics, **medium** on the current build (link-only), **weak-medium single-source** on post-1.18.1 standing (`feral-tank.md`) | **medium** (`restoration-healer.md`); two build philosophies, no decoded point lists | **strong** on rotation and the powershift-vs-bleed evolution, **medium** on gear, **weak single-source** on post-1.18.1 items (`feral-melee-dps.md`) | **strong** on mechanics (two long write-ups + dozens of replies), **medium** on the post-1.18.1 numbers (`balance-ranged-dps.md`) | Feral **weak** (only build link is pre-CC2 and superseded); Balance **medium**; Resto **strong on the Rogue matchup, weak elsewhere** | **medium**: strong on spec framing and talent-order anchors, weak-to-none on route/rank-skips |
| **Hunter** | **none** | **none** | **strong** (`survival-melee-dps.md`): consensus rotati
matrixMarkdown:
Cross-class index built **only** from the nine class folders in this repo (`synthesis/classes/<class>/README.md`, the 47 spec×role playbooks and the nine `leveling.md` files) plus their YAML twins in `structured/classes/`. Conventions: [`../CONVENTIONS.md`](../CONVENTIONS.md). Machine-readable twin: [`../../structured/classes/spec-role-matrix.yaml`](../../structured/classes/spec-role-matrix.yaml).

No vanilla assumptions are used to decide viability: Turtle rewrote the class kits three times inside the extraction window (Class Changes 2 = 1.17.2, staff post 2024-10-12, live 2024-11-01; Class Changes 3 = 1.18.0, staff post 2025-07-25, live 2025-08-15; 1.18.1, staff post [Jamey (staff), 2026-01-23](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=166071#p166071) with revision blocks 2026-01-26 and 2026-03-19, live 2026-03-20), and made several non-vanilla roles real — Enhancement Shaman tank, melee Survival Hunter, melee-weaving Holy Paladin, Subtlety support Rogue, Firelock, Smite Priest. Where sources say a role does not exist for a class, this file says **not viable** and cites the source, rather than inferring it.

**Roles** are the six named in the task: tank, healer, melee DPS, ranged DPS, PvP, leveling. **Standing** is one of `favored` (the community's default pick for that class+role), `alternative` (a real, played choice with a stated reason to pick it), `niche` (a small, specific use-case or a handful of practitioners), `not viable` (sources say the class cannot fill the role). **Agreement** is `consensus` / `single source` / `contested` per `CONVENTIONS.md`.

**Era labels**: **pre-1.18.1** (before 2025-10-03), **1.18.1-announced-pre-release** (2025-10-03 .. 2026-03-19), **post-1.18.1** (from 2026-03-20). The forum extractions end between 2026-04-06 and 2026-04-18;
